summary: Forensic event playback and immutable snapshot request with per-tenant identity-hash and reorder-proof manifest
description: Issue summary: Customer requests a time-bounded forensic event playback and an immutable snapshot of audit events for compliance review. Impact: Customer needs ordered event playback for a 72-hour incident window (2026-02-26T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-01T23:59:59Z) to validate external data leakage claims. They require per-event identity-hash (non-reversible) so auditors can correlate identities without receiving raw PII. Deliverable expectations: a replayable dataset and an immutable manifest allowing reorder-proof verification, per-event HMAC with rotating KEK, signed checkpoint files, and a redaction mapping file. Preferred transport: S3 presigned, or SFTP with signed manifest. Constraints: Do not include raw customer user emails or raw prompts in the export; provide pseudonymized id and a separate mapping hashed with a customer-supplied salt stored in their KMS. Requestor provided SCCM ticket and regulatory timeline requiring delivery within 7 business days.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer identified an incident window and requested complete audit sequence for tenant 'finscribe-prod'.
2) Support to provide specification for export format, hashing, and delivery mechanism.
3) Engineering to prepare immutable snapshot and manifest, validate HMAC chain, and produce redaction-proof playback instructions.
expected_output_spec: - File format: parquet (row-grouped by hour) plus newline-delimited JSON for replay script
- Fields: event_id, timestamp_utc, tenant_id_pseudo, event_type, metadata_refs, event_payload_hash, hmac_chain_link
- Per-event identity_hash: sha256(user_id || customer_salt) returned as hex (non-reversible), mapping file delivered separately encrypted with customer KMS key
- Manifest: signed JSONL checkpoints every 1M events containing cumulative SHA256 checkpoint, start_ts, end_ts, and presigned object path
- Chain proof: each checkpoint includes previous_checkpoint_hash to make reorder-proof chain, final manifest signed using Redwood KMS key (customer verified thumbprint).
constraints_and_security: - No raw prompts, PII, or unredacted emails exported without explicit written approval from customer security team.
- If customer requests raw identifiers, require Data Processing Agreement addendum and explicit OSS signed consent.
- Use tenant-scoped HMAC key rotation policy; do not export active KEKs. Provide verification artifacts instead (signed HMACs).
